records.summary: Defeat Cassius Morten, the traitor of the Calphadean line.

steps.text: Hunt Cassius Morten through Calphade Castle.
Defeat him.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: All Quiet on the Front
records.summary: Carry word of the victory to Marquis Lanford.

steps.text: Find Marquis Lanford after the castle is taken.
Report the victory.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: News of Victory
records.summary: Light the beacon that tells the line the castle has fallen.

prerequisites.text: Complete All Quiet on the Front

steps.text: Reach the beacon raised for this signal.
Light it.

sources.title: GameRant: main story quests and chapter list

records.name: Return Home
records.summary: Speak with the comrades who come back from the Calphadean war.

steps.text: Leave Calphade Castle for the people who fought with you.
Speak with those comrades.

records.name: Trial of the Winds
records.summary: Mandatory chapter 2 quest at the first Ancient Obelisk; completing it unlocks gliding.
records.body: This is the gliding trial reached during Chapter 2: Golden Greed, at the first Ancient Obelisk; it is not a listed main-story quest.

prerequisites.text: Reach chapter 2 of the main story

steps.text: Travel to the first Ancient Obelisk the quest marks.
Complete the trial at the obelisk.

records.name: Early Encounter
records.summary: Short side quest near the Timberturner Wainwright, north of the Nas River, that unlocks the 1,000-slot Collectibles Chest.

steps.text: Find the Timberturner Wainwright north of the Nas River in Hernand and speak to the quest giver.
Complete the errand; the Collectibles Chest opens afterwards for quest items, lore notes and learned recipe books.
